outcome: Participants' opinions on the usefulness of maternal cardiac arrest simulation training
Participants' confidence in managing maternal cardiac arrest
Participants' perception of the usefulness of the perimortem caesarean section model
cohort: 134 healthcare professionals who participated in the Advanced Life Support in Obstetrics provider course in April 2021.
finding: Maternal cardiac arrest simulation training was highly valued by all levels of obstetric, emergency medicine and anaesthesia staff in both public and private hospitals.
